description: This file is an entry point for a React application that initializes the rendering of the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the root render node and wraps the application in React.StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React element in which the React app will be rendered.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React components into the root DOM node.
